layout.poster: flex column; min-height: max(900px,100svh); controls in document flow

display.purpose: Meaningful near-full-screen words; user-pinned scale exceeds ordinary display floor.

motion.name: scrubbed-composition
motion.purpose: One direct input changes word offset, rotation and software width; no automatic motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Still composition / Movement off / Movement disabled: no changing alignment announcement; controls skip Tab and react to live preference changes.

components.name: Typographic action
components.description: Unboxed underline action for aligning the words.

components.name: Composition scrubber
components.html: <label class="ds-range-label">Bring it into sync <input class="ds-range" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="65"></label>

narrative.overview: The words are the material: a drenched two-tone violet field gives readable technological ideas almost architectural scale. One controlled typographic movement makes coordination tangible without a tool console, diagram or invented work sample.
keyCharacteristics: Literal software, process and people language.

rules.name: The Readable Motion Rule
rules.body: Every word remains complete at both scrubber extremes; the slider changes composition, never the factual words.

dos: Do let meaningful words own the surface.
Do retain legibility at every input value.
Do keep factual scope separate from commercial proof.
donts: Don't add portrait, cards, diagram or console chrome to this study.
Don't carry this composition into sibling concepts as a template.
